frame.note: Origin at Sgr A*; axes parallel to IAU Galactic axes (x from the Sun toward the center, y along rotation, z to the north Galactic pole). R0 from GRAVITY 2022; the Sun moves at 30.39 km/s/kpc x R0 (Reid & Brunthaler 2020) with U, W from Schoenrich et al. 2010. The Sun's 20.8 pc height above the midplane is not applied.

model.name: gala MilkyWayPotential v1 (Price-Whelan 2017; disk from Bovy 2015) plus the Sgr A* point mass (GRAVITY 2022)

pattern.note: Schematic four-arm log spiral: pitch 13.1 deg (Vallee 2017), pattern speed 28.2 km/s/kpc (Dias et al. 2019), anchored so the Sagittarius-Carina arm crosses the Sun-center line 7.0 kpc from the center. The arm count and pattern speed of the real Milky Way are still debated.

provenance.what: globular clusters and satellite galaxies with full 3D position and velocity
provenance.license: BSD-3-Clause (galpy); data from Vasiliev & Baumgardt 2021, Baumgardt et al. 2019, Baumgardt & Vasiliev 2021, Pace et al. 2022, Gaia Collaboration (Helmi et al.) 2018

provenance.what: pulsars: position, distance, spin, binary period
provenance.license: GPL-2.0-or-later (Stellarium); derived from the ATNF Pulsar Catalogue v2.9.0 (Manchester et al. 2005)
provenance.note: distance = independent estimate when listed, else dispersion-measure estimate (typical error 20 to 40%); 231 pulsars ride with a globular cluster or satellite they sit in; 426 carry their measured proper motion (line-of-sight part assumed equal to local rotation, since pulsar radial velocities cannot be measured); characteristic age = P/(2 Pdot), kept only between 100 yr and 13 Gyr (58 implausible values dropped)

provenance.excluded: 393A (source lists 34 kly; published distances of its likely remnant RX J1713.7-3946 are near 3.3 kly; conflict, not plotted); 1885A (outside the Milky Way system, 2400 kly); 1972E (outside the Milky Way system, 10900 kly)
provenance.note: remnant distances are uncertain by 20 to 50%

provenance.what: gravitational-wave event catalog: time, source masses, distance, final mass
provenance.file: events.csv (Gravitational Wave Open Science Center event portal export, supplied by the owner 2026-11-15)
provenance.license: CC BY 4.0 (GWOSC data policy); cite the GWTC papers
provenance.note: radiated energy = (m1 + m2 - final mass) c^2 in the source frame, for 276 events; left blank for 3 where the separate median values give zero or less (each column is its own median, so their difference is only an estimate); GPS time to UTC uses the 18 s leap-second offset valid since 2017 (up to 1 s early for the 2015-2016 events); no sky positions in this file
